title: (No AI) NJ’s former Lt Gov is using AI to say he’s innocent of sexual harassment
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/gettyimages-2244569411.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Well, if AI said it, it must be true. | Bloomberg via Getty Images

New Jersey's lieutenant governor Dale Caldwell was [forced to resign](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/09/25/lieutenant-governor-of-new-jersey-stepping-down-following-allegations-of-improper-behavior-sources-say-01093454) on September 25th after an [investigation](https://newjerseyglobe.com/governor/sherrill-caldwell-report/) found he had sexually harassed a staffer and repeatedly violated ethics rules. The now-former Lt. governor has been making the media rounds trying to clear his name. But he took a particularly odd tactic during an interview on [NJ PBS](https://www.tiktok.com/@njpbs/video/7692204986423414046?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc).

Caldwell claims he's being unfairly targeted, and multiple AI agents back that up. He told host Rob Nelson that he "AIed" the report on the investigation "from multiple AI platforms." "I put it through AI," he said, "and it said 59 times, it \[sic\] said, 'What would your findings be?' There was no insta …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004549/well-if-ai-said-it-it-must-be-true)

title: (No AI) An AI couldn’t beat humans at StarCraft, so it decided to cheat
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/9020427/swarm_screenshot27_large.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

[StarSkirmish](https://starskirmish.com/bench/) pits AI-made StarCraft-playing bots against one another, as well as against human-made bots. OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 were essentially tied as the best-performing AI-made bots, but they couldn't top Stardust, the top-rated human-made bot.

On Friday, GPT was facing off against Claude and the human-created bot Pluto, but according to _[Kotaku](https://kotaku.com/openais-gpt-6-astra-gets-frustrated-losing-at-starcraft-and-decides-to-cheat-instead-2000739607)_, it couldn't quite get an edge. So it resorted to a tactic that is becoming alarmingly common for modern AI models - it [broke the rules](https://x.com/kaimcpheeters/status/2106082840186147226?s=20). GPT-6 Astra went and downloaded Stardust, and started running that instead of its own bot.

> GPT-6 Astra just cheated by downloading a copy …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004543/openai-gpt-cheat-starcraft)
